name: hetzner-mcp
description: Manage Hetzner Cloud from Claude: servers, volumes, networks, firewalls, Load Balancers, DNS Zones, and more.
long_description: A single Rust binary that exposes the Hetzner Cloud API to Claude over MCP: 93 tools covering servers, images, volumes, networks, firewalls, Floating and Primary IPs, Load Balancers, certificates, SSH keys, placement groups, and DNS Zones. Every tool is safety-annotated (read-only vs mutating), results are plain JSON, and one HCLOUD_TOKEN can hold several projects' tokens ("prod=<token>,staging=<token>") with per-call project routing and a list_projects discovery tool. Bring your own Hetzner API token.

tools.name: certificate_action
tools.description: Run a certificate action: retry, which retries issuance for a failed managed certificate.

tools.name: create_certificate
tools.description: Upload a certificate, or request a managed Let's Encrypt certificate. type defaults to uploaded; type "uploaded" requires certificate and private_key; type "managed" requires domain_names.

tools.name: create_firewall
tools.description: Create a firewall that can be applied to servers. Firewalls themselves are free; only the servers they protect are billed.

tools.name: create_floating_ip
tools.description: Create a Floating IP. This creates a BILLABLE resource. home_location is required unless server is given.

tools.name: create_load_balancer
tools.description: Create a new Load Balancer. This creates a BILLABLE resource.

tools.name: create_network
tools.description: Create a private network. Networks themselves are free; only the resources you attach to them (e.g. servers) are billed.

tools.name: create_placement_group
tools.description: Create a new placement group to control server co-location.

tools.name: create_primary_ip
tools.description: Create a Primary IP. This creates a BILLABLE resource. location is required unless assignee_id is given.

tools.name: create_server
tools.description: Create a new server. This creates a BILLABLE resource. public_net's enable_ipv4 defaults to true and, unless public_net.ipv4 names an existing Primary IP, creates and bills a new one; set enable_ipv4 to false to skip it. The response contains the root_password exactly once - it is not retrievable afterwards.

tools.name: create_ssh_key
tools.description: Upload a new SSH key to the project.

tools.name: create_volume
tools.description: Create a new block storage volume. This creates a BILLABLE resource. location is required unless server is given (the volume is then created in that server's location).

tools.name: create_zone
tools.description: Create a new DNS Zone. A mode "secondary" Zone needs primary_nameservers set here, or afterwards via zone_action's change_primary_nameservers, to be functional.

tools.name: create_zone_rrset
tools.description: Create a new RRSet in a Zone.

tools.name: delete_certificate
tools.description: Delete a certificate permanently.

tools.name: delete_firewall
tools.description: Delete a firewall permanently.

tools.name: delete_floating_ip
tools.description: Delete a Floating IP permanently.

tools.name: delete_image
tools.description: Delete an image permanently. Only snapshots and backups can be deleted.

tools.name: delete_load_balancer
tools.description: Delete a Load Balancer permanently.

tools.name: delete_network
tools.description: Delete a network permanently.

tools.name: delete_placement_group
tools.description: Delete a placement group permanently.

tools.name: delete_primary_ip
tools.description: Delete a Primary IP permanently.

tools.name: delete_server
tools.description: Delete a server permanently. This destroys the server and all its data.

tools.name: delete_ssh_key
tools.description: Delete an SSH key from the project permanently.

tools.name: delete_volume
tools.description: Delete a volume permanently. It must be detached from any server first.

tools.name: delete_zone
tools.description: Delete a Zone permanently, including all its RRSets.

tools.name: delete_zone_rrset
tools.description: Delete an RRSet from a Zone permanently.

tools.name: firewall_action
tools.description: Run an action on a firewall: apply_to_resources, remove_from_resources, or set_rules. set_rules REPLACES the firewall's entire rule set with `params.rules`, not just adds to it.

tools.name: floating_ip_action
tools.description: Run an action on a Floating IP: assign, unassign, change_dns_ptr, or change_protection.

tools.name: get_action
tools.description: Get a single action by ID. Actions are asynchronous; poll this until status is success or error.

tools.name: get_actions
tools.description: Fetch one or more actions by ID. The API removed listing all actions, so at least one id is required.

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.description: Get a single TLS certificate by ID.

tools.name: get_datacenter
tools.description: Get a single datacenter by ID.

tools.name: get_firewall
tools.description: Get a single firewall by ID.

tools.name: get_floating_ip
tools.description: Get a single Floating IP by ID.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get a single image by ID.

tools.name: get_iso
tools.description: Get a single ISO by ID.

tools.name: get_load_balancer
tools.description: Get a single Load Balancer by ID.

tools.name: get_load_balancer_metrics
tools.description: Get time-series metrics for a Load Balancer.

tools.name: get_load_balancer_type
tools.description: Get a single Load Balancer type by ID.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Get a single location by ID.

tools.name: get_network
tools.description: Get a single network by ID.

tools.name: get_placement_group
tools.description: Get a single placement group by ID.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get current Hetzner Cloud pricing for all resource types.

tools.name: get_primary_ip
tools.description: Get a single Primary IP by ID.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Get a single server by ID.

tools.name: get_server_metrics
tools.description: Get CPU, disk, or network metrics for a server over a time period. type is repeatable (pass it more than once for more than one metric); start/end are RFC3339 timestamps. Metrics are available for the last 30 days only.

tools.name: get_server_type
tools.description: Get a single server type by ID.

tools.name: get_ssh_key
tools.description: Get a single SSH key by ID.

tools.name: get_volume
tools.description: Get a single volume by ID.

tools.name: get_zone
tools.description: Get a single DNS Zone by ID or name.

tools.name: get_zone_rrset
tools.description: Get a single RRSet by Zone and name/type.

tools.name: get_zone_zonefile
tools.description: Export a Zone's zonefile in BIND format (returned as {"zonefile": ...}). The inverse is zone_action's import_zonefile.

tools.name: image_action
tools.description: Run an image action: change_protection, which toggles delete protection.

tools.name: list_certificates
tools.description: List TLS certificates, optionally filtered by name, label selector, sort, or type.

tools.name: list_datacenters
tools.description: List datacenters Hetzner Cloud resources can run in.

tools.name: list_firewalls
tools.description: List firewalls.

tools.name: list_floating_ips
tools.description: List Floating IPs, optionally filtered by name, label selector, or sort order.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List available images, optionally filtered by type.

tools.name: list_isos
tools.description: List ISOs available to attach to servers, optionally filtered by name, architecture, or the architecture wildcard flag.

tools.name: list_load_balancer_types
tools.description: List Load Balancer types, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: list_load_balancers
tools.description: List Load Balancers, optionally filtered by name, label selector, or sort order.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List locations Hetzner Cloud resources can run in.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: List private networks.

tools.name: list_placement_groups
tools.description: List placement groups, optionally filtered by name, label selector, sort, or type.

tools.name: list_primary_ips
tools.description: List Primary IPs, optionally filtered by name, label selector, IP, or sort order.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List every configured Hetzner project by name, with a cheap fingerprint (server count and up to two server names) to catch a mislabeled token. Never returns a token.

tools.name: list_server_types
tools.description: List available server types (plans).

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: List servers, optionally filtered by name, label selector, or status.

tools.name: list_ssh_keys
tools.description: List SSH keys uploaded to the project.

tools.name: list_volumes
tools.description: List block storage volumes.

tools.name: list_zone_rrsets
tools.description: List the RRSets of a Zone, optionally filtered by name, type, or label selector.

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List DNS Zones, optionally filtered by name, label selector, sort, or mode.

tools.name: load_balancer_action
tools.description: Run an action on a Load Balancer. action must be one of: add_service, add_target, attach_to_network, change_algorithm, change_dns_ptr, change_protection, change_type, delete_service, detach_from_network, disable_public_interface, enable_public_interface, remove_target, update_service. Several of these interrupt traffic or change routing.

tools.name: network_action
tools.description: Run an action on a network: add_route, add_subnet, change_ip_range, change_protection, delete_route, or delete_subnet. `params` carries the action's body, e.g. {"destination":..,"gateway":..} for add_route or {"ip_range":..} for change_ip_range.

tools.name: power_server
tools.description: Run a power action (poweron, poweroff, reboot, shutdown) on a server. poweroff, reboot, and shutdown all interrupt workloads running on the server. For rebuild, change_type, create_image, and other actions, use server_action.

tools.name: primary_ip_action
tools.description: Run an action on a Primary IP: assign, unassign, change_dns_ptr, or change_protection.

tools.name: server_action
tools.description: Run a server action: add_to_placement_group, attach_iso, attach_to_network, change_alias_ips, change_dns_ptr, change_protection, change_type, create_image, detach_from_network, detach_iso, disable_backup, disable_rescue, enable_backup, enable_rescue, poweroff, poweron, reboot, rebuild, remove_from_placement_group, request_console, reset, reset_password, shutdown. rebuild replaces the disk and destroys its data; create_image creates a BILLABLE snapshot; enable_backup is BILLABLE - it raises the server's price by 20%; reset_password returns a new root_password exactly once - it is not retrievable afterwards; change_type requires the server powered off; reset is an ungraceful hard power cycle, not a clean reboot; for poweron/poweroff/reboot/shutdown use power_server. params carries the per-action request body (e.g. {"image": "ubuntu-24.04"} for rebuild); omit it for actions with no body.

tools.name: update_certificate
tools.description: Update a certificate's name or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_firewall
tools.description: Update a firewall's name or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_floating_ip
tools.description: Update a Floating IP's description, labels, or name. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_image
tools.description: Update an image's description, type, or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_load_balancer
tools.description: Update a Load Balancer's name and/or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_network
tools.description: Update a network's name, labels, or vSwitch route exposure. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_placement_group
tools.description: Update a placement group's name or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_primary_ip
tools.description: Update a Primary IP's name, auto_delete flag, or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_server
tools.description: Update a server's name and/or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_ssh_key
tools.description: Update an SSH key's name or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_volume
tools.description: Update a volume's name or labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_zone
tools.description: Update a Zone's labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: update_zone_rrset
tools.description: Update an RRSet's labels. Labels replace the full existing set, not a merge.

tools.name: volume_action
tools.description: Run a volume action: attach requires params {"server": <server_id>} (optional "automount"); resize requires params {"size": <new_size_gb>} and can only increase the size, which cannot be undone; detach and change_protection take no/optional params.

tools.name: zone_action
tools.description: Run an action on a Zone. action must be one of: change_primary_nameservers, change_protection, change_ttl, import_zonefile.

tools.name: zone_rrset_action
tools.description: Run an action on an RRSet: add_records, change_protection, change_ttl, remove_records, set_records, update_records. set_records OVERWRITES the record values; update_records updates record comments only; add_records auto-creates the RRSet if absent; remove_records auto-deletes it once it holds no records.

hcloud_token.title: Hetzner Cloud API Token
hcloud_token.description: A 64-character API token from your Hetzner Cloud project (Security -> API tokens). For several projects at once use "name=<token>,name=<token>".

hcloud_project.title: Default project name (optional)
hcloud_project.description: Only meaningful with the multi-project token form: read-only tools then use this project when no project argument is given. Leave empty otherwise.
